basis: Disease of the vestibular labyrinth; imbalance does not establish separate neurologic damage.
Zellweger peroxisomal disorder with cortical malformation and hepatic injury; tricuspid regurgitation in 2/4; renal, ocular and hearing findings individually 25%.
Neurodevelopmental disorder; joint hypermobility in 7/13 and visual impairment in 6/15. Recurrent infections do not establish immunodeficiency; constipation alone is insufficient.
Contractures, skeletal fusions and cutaneous pterygia define the syndrome; ptosis in 5/9 affects eyelids. Ventricular septal defect in 2/7 is below 30%.
Skin/hair hypopigmentation and neurologic impairment define GS1; retinopathy in 80-99%, hyperlipidemia in 30-79%. Explicitly lacks immunodeficiency.
Maternal anti-Rh alloantibodies destroy fetal red cells. Kernicterus and hydrops-related organ complications are not established in at least 30%.
Disorder of the eye's focusing mechanism.
Mesothelial neoplasm originating in the pleura.
DIC with necrotic purpura, usually infection-triggered or postinfectious immune-mediated; vessel thrombosis in 30-79%. Hepatic failure and intracranial hemorrhage are below 30%.
Localized abnormal elastic tissue in the dermis; definition explicitly states no systemic involvement.
Pontocerebellar and anterior horn degeneration; muscle atrophy in 80-99%, optic atrophy/visual loss in 30-79%. Respiratory failure reflects neuromuscular weakness.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy; reproductive tumour origin has no axis and does not imply endocrine dysfunction.
CYP1B1-related congenital glaucoma with anterior segment abnormalities; confined to the ocular axis.
Inherited cataract; extraocular findings of individual syndromic subtypes do not apply across this umbrella.
IFT172 skeletal ciliopathy; nephronophthisis, hepatic fibrosis and retinal degeneration occur in roughly 30% or more. Thoracic restriction arises from skeletal dysplasia.
Mitochondrial leukodystrophy; cardiomyopathy and Fanconi tubulopathy each 30-79%. Cap omits frequent ocular, hepatic, muscle, hearing and hematologic involvement.
Francisella infection; pneumonia is annotated frequent (30-79%), supporting pulmonary involvement. Supplied skin and ocular lesion frequencies are below 30%.
Congenital secretory diarrhea; hepatic steatosis with elevated transaminases and recurrent hypoglycemia each occur in 5/5 patients.
Anomaly of myelinated retinal/optic nerve fibers; the optic nerve is included in the ocular axis.
Granuloma located in the lacrimal drainage system; granuloma alone does not establish infection or autoimmune disease.
Neurodevelopmental disorder defined by impaired communication and social development; neurodevelopmental disorders belong to the neurologic axis.
Defining skeletal anomalies, microcephaly/intellectual disability and cleft lip/palate; horseshoe kidney occurs in 30-79%. Reproductive anomalies have no axis.
Hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome. Other associated cancers are future risks and separate diseases, not direct extraintestinal involvement.
Malignancy of myeloid blood and marrow cells; no extrahematologic organ damage is established in at least 30%.
Mucocele of the lacrimal sac from drainage obstruction; inflammation alone does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism.
